summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. III, a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to its Business Combination Agreement with Air Water Ventures Holdings Limited. The amendment reduces aggregate base consideration from $300M to $200M and revises earnout triggers based on revenue/EBITDA run rates and share price targets. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The transaction remains subject to stockholder approvals. Watch for shareholder reaction to the lower consideration and earnout feasibility, with risk-arb focusing on deal-closing probability and redemption levels.
